intro.en: Industrial Ethernet and RJ45 cable assemblies link PLCs, remote I/O, switches, vision equipment and service ports. We build RJ45 patch leads, M12 D/X-to-RJ45 transitions, panel extensions and equipment tails to a specified pair map, shield plan, route and acceptance target.
intro.zh: 工业以太网与 RJ45 电缆组件连接 PLC、远程 I/O、工业交换机、视觉设备与维护端口。可按指定线对映射、屏蔽方案、走线路径及验收目标，制作 RJ45 引线、M12 D/X 编码转 RJ45、面板延长线和设备尾线。

knowledge.en: The link is a complete transmission path, not two identical plugs on a length of cable. Pair count and assignment, cable category, conductor construction, shield termination, connector design, installation route and agreed test limit must work together. An M12 D-coded interface and an M12 X-coded interface are different geometries; a transition to an 8P8C modular plug must follow the released equipment pin schedule.
knowledge.zh: 这类组件是一条完整的传输路径，不是在线材两端装上外形相同的插头。线对数量与分配、线缆等级、导体结构、屏蔽端接、连接器设计、安装路径和约定测试限值必须协同。M12 D 编码与 M12 X 编码属于不同接口几何，转接至常被称为 RJ45 的 8P8C 模块化插头时，应遵循已放行的设备针脚表。

notes.en: Send the network protocol and target data rate, exact device ports and connector part numbers, two- or four-pair requirement, pin map, cable category and length, fixed or moving route, shield and bonding plan, PoE load where relevant, oil/temperature/washdown exposure, exit direction, labels, quantity and required verification or certification limit.
notes.zh: 请提供网络协议与目标速率、设备端口及连接器准确型号、两对或四对线要求、针脚表、线缆等级与长度、固定或运动走线、屏蔽及接地方案、相关 PoE 负载、油污/温度/冲洗环境、出线方向、标签、数量，以及所需线序核查或等级认证限值。

delivery.en: We review the drawing, sample or interface schedule before selecting a cable and termination system. The approved sample should freeze both ends, pair map, length datum, shield handling, boot or overmold geometry, marking and acceptance method. Continuity and wire-map checks are not proof of a specified Ethernet channel class; performance certification requires the agreed instrument, adapters, standard and limit.
delivery.zh: 选线与确定端接体系前，先审核图纸、样品或接口表。批准样品应冻结两端接口、线对映射、长度基准、屏蔽处理、护套或包覆成型几何、标识与验收方法。导通和线序检查不能证明某一以太网信道等级；性能认证需要约定仪器、适配器、标准与限值。

introduction.en: Define the Link Before Choosing the Plug
introduction.zh: 先定义链路，再选择接头

faq.zh: 工业以太网电缆组件常见问题

lead.en: A good drawing identifies both device ports, every twisted pair, the shield, cable route and the acceptance target. We then select the connector, jacket and termination around that defined link—whether the assembly ends in two RJ45 plugs, an M12-to-RJ45 transition or a panel interface.
lead.zh: 一份可制造的图纸应先明确两端设备端口、每组双绞线对、屏蔽层、走线路径与验收目标。之后再围绕这条链路确定连接器、护套和端接方式，无论成品是双 RJ45 插头、M12 转 RJ45，还是面板接口。

title.en: RJ45, M12 and panel transitions are different builds
title.zh: RJ45、M12 与面板转接不是同一种组件

copy.en: RJ45-to-RJ45 leads serve cabinet and equipment links; M12 D- or X-coded transitions connect machine ports to modular ports; panel feedthroughs move a service interface to an accessible surface. Straight or angled exits, locking boots, overmolds, length, labels and protective caps follow the installation. M12 coding, contact count and pair assignment must be checked against port documentation rather than inferred from a photograph.
copy.zh: RJ45 对 RJ45 引线可用于控制柜和设备间连接；M12 D 或 X 编码转接线把机端接口引向模块化端口；面板穿通件把维护接口移至可接近的位置。直出或弯出、防脱护套、包覆成型、线长、标签和防护帽都依安装配置。M12 编码、触点数量和线对分配必须对照端口文件，不能由照片推断。

copy.en: Specify the actual interface and pair map; a modular shell does not define active pairs.
copy.zh: 依据实际接口确定线对和映射，模块化外壳本身不定义有效线对数量。

title.zh: 分别定义 A、B 两端

copy.en: Part number, orientation, exit direction and finished-length datum belong on the drawing.
copy.zh: 料号、插头方向、出线方向与成品长度基准应写入图纸。

title.en: Pair geometry, shield and jacket belong to one selection
title.zh: 线对结构、屏蔽与护套需要一起选

copy.en: The requested channel class is assessed across cable and compatible connectors, not by jacket marking alone. Fixed runs and repeatedly moving equipment need different conductor and jacket constructions. Pair twist and any foil or braid should remain controlled through termination; excessive untwist or an interrupted shield path can undermine the intended performance. PVC, PUR and other jackets are reviewed against bend duty, temperature, oil, abrasion and cleaning exposure.
copy.zh: 目标链路等级要结合线材与兼容连接器评估，不能只看外护套印字。固定走线与反复运动设备对导体和护套结构的要求不同。端接时需控制线对绞距及箔层或编织层处理；过长的散绞段或中断的屏蔽路径可能破坏预期性能。PVC、PUR 等护套应按弯曲工况、温度、油污、磨耗和清洁环境审核。

copy.en: Solid and stranded conductors may require different compatible contacts and preparation.
copy.zh: 实心与绞合导体可能需要不同的适配触点及预处理。

copy.en: Define where the shield is bonded; shielded cable alone does not define grounding.
copy.zh: 明确屏蔽层在哪里连接；使用屏蔽线本身不等于已定义接地。

title.en: PoE adds current and heat review to the data path
title.zh: PoE 让数据路径同时面对电流和温升

copy.en: If equipment is powered over the data link, define the PoE mode and actual load before selecting conductor size, contact system, cable length and bundle density. Electrical resistance and heating in a tight bundle matter alongside data transmission. The switch pictured here is application context, not evidence that every cable on this page supports a particular PoE class or power level.
copy.zh: 若设备通过数据链路供电，应先明确 PoE 模式和实际负载，再选择导体截面积、触点体系、线长及成束密度。密集线束中的电阻和温升与数据传输同样需要考虑。图中交换机仅说明应用场景，不代表本页每种线缆都支持某一 PoE 等级或功率。

copy.en: Port and powered-device requirements are inputs, not assumptions based on an RJ45 appearance.
copy.zh: 供电端口与受电设备要求是输入条件，不能凭 RJ45 外观假定。

copy.en: Cable grouping, ambient temperature and route influence the final choice.
copy.zh: 成束、环境温度和走线路径都会影响最终选型。

title.en: Panel boundaries and motion change the mechanical design
title.zh: 面板边界与运动工况会改变机械设计

copy.en: A cabinet patch lead, machine-side M12 lead and panel pass-through see different pull, vibration, washdown and service loads. Review connector access, bend radius, strain relief, routing near drives and power cables, gland or gasket interfaces and service loops. An ingress rating belongs to a specified mated and installed configuration; it is not inherited by an entire assembly merely because one connector carries an IP label.
copy.zh: 柜内跳线、机端 M12 引线和面板穿通件承受的拉力、振动、冲洗与维护载荷各不相同。需审核插拔空间、弯曲半径、应力释放、与驱动器或动力线的邻近走线、压紧件或密封垫界面以及检修余量。防护等级属于规定的对插及安装配置，不能因为某个连接器标有 IP 等级就自动赋予整条组件。

copy.en: Repeated flexing is a cable-system requirement, not solved by a thicker boot alone.
copy.zh: 反复弯曲是整套线材结构的要求，不能只靠加厚尾套解决。

copy.en: Specify which side of the panel receives the plug, seal, lock and label.
copy.zh: 标明插头、密封、锁紧和标签分别位于面板哪一侧。

title.en: Keep the approved pair map through every termination
title.zh: 让已批准的线对映射贯穿每一次端接

copy.en: The production file identifies cable and plug part numbers, strip dimensions, pair map, contact or termination method, shield preparation, boot or overmold geometry and finished-length reference. The first article is checked before repetition. The pictured tools are editorial context: the actual tool, die, setting and inspection point depend on the released connector system. Color order alone is not a substitute for a controlled pin schedule.
copy.zh: 生产文件应明确线材及插头料号、剥线尺寸、线对映射、触点或端接方法、屏蔽预处理、护套或包覆成型几何及成品长度基准。首件确认后再重复生产。图中工具仅作工艺示意，实际工具、模具、设定值和检查点取决于已放行连接器体系；线色顺序不能代替受控针脚表。

copy.en: Prevent pair splits, misplaced contacts and uncontrolled untwist at both ends.
copy.zh: 避免两端出现拆对、触点错位和失控散绞。

copy.en: A material or connector substitution triggers review of fit and test scope.
copy.zh: 材料或连接器替换应重新审核配合关系与测试范围。

title.en: Wire-map verification is not performance certification
title.zh: 线序核查不等于性能认证

copy.en: Routine inspection can check material identity, length, label, visual workmanship, latch, continuity, pair map, shorts and shield connection as specified. Network qualification or category certification asks a different question and needs the defined standard, limit, calibrated instrument and suitable adapters. Link communication on one machine is useful functional evidence but does not certify every installed channel. The acceptance plan states which result is required for this order.
copy.zh: 常规检验可按约定核对材料身份、长度、标签、外观工艺、锁扣、导通、线对映射、短路与屏蔽连接。网络资格验证或等级认证回答的是另一类问题，需要明确标准、限值、经校准的仪器和适配器。某台设备能够通信是有用的功能证据，但不能据此认证所有已安装信道。每笔订单应在验收计划中写明所需结果。

copy.en: A patch cord, permanent link and full channel have different test boundaries.
copy.zh: 跳线、永久链路和完整信道的测试边界不同。

copy.en: Record sample or lot, instrument, limit and result when reports are requested.
copy.zh: 客户要求报告时记录样品或批次、仪器、限值和结果。

title.en: One category spans cabinets, cells and field devices
title.zh: 同一小类覆盖控制柜、产线单元与现场设备

copy.en: Typical projects include PLC-to-switch cabinet links, remote-I/O drops, industrial cameras, HMI and service-port leads, machine-tool networks and packaged equipment. Each application changes connector space, maintenance access, route, shielding, possible PoE load and validation target. An assembly can be customized for these interfaces after the real equipment and network requirement are confirmed; the category name is not a promise of universal protocol or device compatibility.
copy.zh: 典型项目包括 PLC 到交换机的柜内连接、远程 I/O 支线、工业相机、HMI 和维护端口引线、机床网络及成套设备。应用变化会改变连接器空间、维护可达性、走线路径、屏蔽、可能的 PoE 负载和验证目标。确认实际设备与网络要求后，可按这些接口定制组件；小类名称并不意味着通用协议或设备兼容承诺。

copy.en: Short runs prioritize clear port identity, service loops and accessible replacement.
copy.zh: 短距连接更重视端口身份、检修余量和便捷更换。

copy.en: Movement, contamination and installation loads become part of the specification.
copy.zh: 运动、污染物和安装载荷需要写入规格。

q.en: Can an RJ45-looking plug guarantee Gigabit Ethernet?
q.zh: 外形像 RJ45 的插头就能保证千兆以太网吗？

a.en: No. The complete cable and connector construction, active pairs, pin map, length and measured link performance matter. Agree the required data rate and test limit before production.
a.zh: 不能。完整线材与连接器结构、有效线对、针脚映射、长度和实测链路性能都有关。生产前应约定目标速率与测试限值。

q.en: Can M12 D-coded and X-coded connectors be swapped?
q.zh: M12 D 编码与 X 编码能互换吗？

a.en: No. Their mating geometry and intended pair arrangements differ. Select the exact device-side coding and release the mapping to the modular side.
a.zh: 不能。两者对插几何和预期线对布局不同，应确认设备端准确编码，并放行到模块化接口一侧的映射。

q.en: Does a shielded cable need a shielded plug?
q.zh: 用了屏蔽线就一定需要屏蔽插头吗？

a.en: That depends on the system bonding and EMC design. If a continuous screened path is specified, the plug, shell and termination must support it; a shielded jacket alone cannot establish continuity.
a.zh: 取决于系统接地与电磁兼容方案。若要求连续屏蔽路径，插头、外壳和端接必须共同支持；只有屏蔽线材不能形成完整路径。

q.en: What is the difference between a wire-map test and cable certification?
q.zh: 线序测试与线缆认证有什么区别？

a.en: Wire-map testing checks conductor correspondence and faults such as opens, shorts or split pairs where the tester supports it. Certification applies a defined cabling standard and measured limits to a specified link configuration. One result must not be presented as the other.
a.zh: 线序测试核对导体对应关系，并在仪器支持时检查断路、短路或拆对；认证则针对指定链路配置，按明确布线标准及测量限值判定。两者不能互相替代。

q.en: What information is needed for a custom quotation?
q.zh: 定制报价需要哪些资料？

a.en: Send the device interfaces and part numbers, protocol and rate, pin schedule, cable class and length, fixed or moving installation, shield and PoE requirements, environment, quantities, labels and acceptance method. A verified sample can supplement an incomplete drawing.
a.zh: 请提供设备接口与料号、协议和速率、针脚表、线缆等级与长度、固定或运动安装、屏蔽与 PoE 要求、环境、数量、标签和验收方法。图纸未齐时，可辅以经确认的样品。
